title: Pharmacy Safety Engine + SFDA Batch Tracking

constraints.safety_checks: ALL blocking checks (contraindicated, major, allergy) are HTTP 403 — never advisory-only without override_reason
constraints.override: Override requires reason_code field + emits pharmacy.safety_override audit event
constraints.recall_block: Recalled batch check runs BEFORE safety check in dispense flow

governance_note: Gate closure requires human authority. Claude Code has not approved any gate.
